title: Ninpen Manmaru
overview: Ninpen Manmaru is a 3D action platform game based on the anime and manga known internationally as Manmaru the Ninja Penguin. The story is simple: Manmaru has been sent by his master to train on his own and hone his ninja skills, and his rivals show up to try and thwart him. The game is broken into six themed stages, which each consists of four areas and a boss fight. Each area is a relatively compact area, and the objective is simply to find and reach the goal while collecting coins and avoiding enemies. Boss fights do not involve direct combat, but are instead various competitive minigames, such as a race to collect more coins than the opponent or to be the first to find the exit to a maze.
